pages.title: About
pages.markdown:
## Hello

I write about how ordinary things get made: bridges, bread, software, schedules. I started Your Brand as a weekly note in 2017 and it has grown, slowly, into a small independent publication.

## How I work

One piece a week, researched in the open and corrected in public. No tracking, no paywall for the archive, and an email list that I write to myself.

## Say hello

The best way to reach me is by email. I read everything and answer most of it.
